notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
Nessus is a vulnerability scanner that performs credentialed or uncredentialed scans to identify known CVEs, misconfigurations, missing patches, and compliance gaps. Starting the service activates the scanner's web UI (default port 8834) for configuration and results review.

=== CHAINING ===
Start Nessus → create scan policy (Basic Network, Credentialed, PCI DSS, etc.) → configure targets → run scan → export results (PDF/XML/CSV) → prioritize findings by CVSS → recommend remediation.

=== SCAN TYPES ===
Uncredentialed: identifies network-exposed services and fingerprints but has high false negative rate for patch status. Credentialed: uses SSH/WMI credentials to check installed packages, registry keys, and patch levels — much more accurate.
